notes: All images are synthetic; event timestamps are simulated at manifest creation, not capture timestamps.
Only each entry.event is a Common Event Model payload; wrapper fields are manifest metadata.
Camera IDs in counting/fire-smoke filenames are preserved. Intrusion camera IDs and all site IDs are demo assignments.
Analytics labels and severity are proposed demo classifications based on folders, not image analysis. No measured people count or model confidence is asserted.
Event IDs are deterministic UUID5 values derived from tenant and exact repository-relative filename. Blob URIs are planned references; existence is not asserted.
TENANT-DEV is a demo tenant label, not proof that ingestion authorizes this tenant. No events have been submitted.
